This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
src/export/csv.ts defines a BOM constant and prepends it by default (bom = true) with the comment "Spreadsheet apps use the byte order mark to detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly," and src/api/reports.ts calls writeCsv(rows) using that default, confirming the BOM is intentional and not exposed as a toggle via the API. Nothing needs to change; the reporter's workaround of reading with utf-8-sig is the correct approach.
